6 Aggravation of offence under section 5

(1) This section applies if—
(a) a court is considering the seriousness of an offence under section 5, and
(b) at the time the offence was committe d the offender was aged 18 or over.

(2) If condition A, B or C is met the court—
(a) must treat the fact that the condit ion is met as an aggravating factor
(that is to say, a factor that increases the seriousness of the offence), and
(b) must state in open court that the offence is so aggravated.

(3) Condition A is that the offence was co mmitted on or in th e vicinity of school
premises at a relevant time.
